question: How should the preferences of younger investors shape Edward Jones's offerings?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Schwab reports new-to-firm retail household growth of 1.0M in 2023, 1.1M in 2024, and 1.2M in 2025, a +10% CAGR, driven in part by strong growth and winning with young investors.
Schwab states approximately 70% of new-to-firm retail households are Gen Z and millennials.
items.quote: We are attracting younger clients, approximately 70% of new-to-firm retail households are Gen Z and millennials.
items.unit: new-to-firm retail households that are Gen Z and millennials

items.text: In 2025Q3, Schwab stated industry research shows Gen Z is 45% more likely to start investing by age 21 compared to Millennials, and nearly one-third of new-to-firm retail households at Schwab are Gen Zers (ages 13 to 28).
items.quote: industry research shows Gen Z is 45% more likely to start investing by the age of 21 as compared to Millennials... nearly one-third of new-to-firm retail households at Schwab are Gen Zers, investors between the ages of 13 and 28.
items.unit: likelihood of investing by age 21; new-to-firm retail households that are Gen Z
items.definition: Gen Zers, investors between the ages of 13 and 28

items.text: Schwab states Gen Z investors comprise nearly a third of new retail client accounts opened in 2025, and nearly 60% are under the age of 40.
items.quote: Gen Z investors comprise nearly a third of new retail client accounts opened in 2025, and nearly 60% are under the age of 40.
items.unit: new retail client accounts that are Gen Z; new retail client accounts under age 40

items.text: Schwab's deck reports 61% of new clients are Gen Z & Millennial investors, and +14% new-to-firm retail households and +25% new-to-firm retail NNA growth from 2024 to 2025.
items.quote: 61% Gen Z & Millennial Investors Percent of New Clients 1
items.unit: percent of new clients that are Gen Z & Millennial investors

items.text: Schwab reports one in six new-to-firm retail households are under age 24, more than 30% of new-to-firm clients are under age 30, and nearly 60% are under age 40.
items.quote: one in six new-to-firm retail households are under the age of 24. More than 30% of our new-to-firm clients are under the age of 30, and nearly 60% are under the age of 40.
items.value: one in six; more than 30%; nearly 60%
items.unit: new-to-firm households under age 24; new-to-firm clients under age 30; new-to-firm clients under age 40

items.text: Schwab reports 33% of new-to-firm retail households are under age 30, and more than 50% are under age 40.
items.quote: We are attracting younger investors, with 33% of our new-to-firm retail households under the age of 30, and more than 50% under the age of 40.
items.unit: new-to-firm retail households under age 30; under age 40

items.text: Schwab states 42% of thinkorswim users are Millennial or Gen Z.
items.quote: 42% of thinkorswim→ users are Millennial or Gen Z 1
items.unit: thinkorswim users that are Millennial or Gen Z

items.text: Schwab's average client age has fallen by about 10 years in the last decade and is now in the 40s; a third of new-to-firm clients last year were Gen Z investors.
items.quote: Our average age of our client has fallen by about 10 years in the last decade and is now in the 40s. A third of our new-to-firm clients last year were Gen Z investors
items.unit: decline in average client age; new-to-firm clients that are Gen Z

items.text: Schwab reports ~70% of new-to-firm retail households are Gen Z & Millennials.
items.quote: ~70% NTF Retail HH are Gen Z & Millennials 1

items.text: Schwab states one-third of retail households who created a financial plan within the last two years are under age 40.

items.unit: retail households who created a financial plan under age 40

cells.reason: Multiple passages report growth in younger investors and clients under 40 for Schwab, each as a fact covering the periods or scopes stated.
